description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class KpiServiceTest for testing the performance KPI service in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, mock-based tests for saving KPIs, handling default KPIs, and exception scenarios.

classes.name: KpiServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for KpiService, testing KPI saving, default flag behavior, and error handling scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the KpiService instance and sets up test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetKpiDao
methods.description: Verifies that getKpiDao returns an instance of KpiDao.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests saving a KPI successfully via mocked DAO.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue
methods.description: Tests saving a KPI marked as default and verifies it replaces previous default KPI.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue2
methods.description: Tests re-saving a KPI marked as default, ensuring the previous default KPI is updated accordingly.

methods.name: testKpiServiceExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Checks that saving a KPI with invalid min/max ratings throws KpiServiceException.

methods.name: testTransactionExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Ensures that a TransactionException during save is properly handled and thrown.
